environment: API 36 x86_64 SwiftShader; 420 dpi, font scale 1.0, 3-button navigation; emulator, not device acceptance

interactions.journey: sheet open/close, 6 scroll gestures, detail open/return; stable-row wait before tap

limitations: No before/after comparison; no measured speedup claim.
Startup observations on emulator do not pass the midrange-device 500 ms target.
Positive overrun fraction covers the whole journey; it is not the scrolling-only dropped-frame acceptance metric or FPS.
R8 benchmark APK and delivered Debug APK are not performance-equivalent.

idleMemory.method: Foreground idle; wait 30 seconds, then 3 samples 10 seconds apart; isolated synthetic app
